items.name: Power Management coverage summary
items.description: This panel now surfaces verified mainstream items plus conditional advanced controls with explicit badges and support/proof metadata.

items.name: Export powercfg /qh + /aliases snapshot
items.description: Exports authoritative powercfg evidence for local verification and troubleshooting.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ("power-qh-"+$ts+".txt")); powercfg /aliases | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ("power-aliases-"+$ts+".txt")); Write-Output "Saved powercfg snapshots."

items.name: Run power catalog verification reports
items.description: Regenerates verification and audit report artifacts from the current catalog/manifests.
